suite: Full relevant test suite = repository ctest collection (75 ONNX operator tests, tests/op/test_onnx_op_*.cpp, CPU reference backend) + CUDA-backend on-GPU parity harness (9 ImageNet-style models). This file is a completeness-correction re-run: the previous record ran ONLY the 9-model CUDA demo and reported 9/9 as the whole suite.
run_command: (cd build && ctest --output-on-failure -V --timeout 120)  # 75 registered onnx op tests, CPU reference backend  ;  bash corex_port/test/run_tests.sh  # 9-model CUDA-vs-CPU top-5 parity on GPU 1
scope_note: Only PART B (9 models via tm_classification_cuda) exercises the migrated CUDA backend. PART A (all 75 ctest onnx op tests) runs on the Tengine CPU reference backend via create_graph(nullptr,...) and does NOT touch CUDA; the test binaries hardcode the default (CPU) context so there is no env/flag to point them at the CUDA backend without source edits. All 75 fail at model-load ('cannot open file ../onnx_node/<op>/onnx.tmfile') because the external ONNX node test data is not present and onnx must not be installed/vendored; they never reach inference. They are counted as legitimate skips (missing data file, analogous to a missing weight file) and are out of the CUDA migration scope.
raw_ctest_result: ctest exit=8: 75/75 Failed, 100% with 'cannot open file ../onnx_node/<op>/onnx.tmfile -> Create graph failed' (missing external test data at load time; no inference reached). Full verbose output is in test.log PART A. Reclassified here as skipped(legitimate), NOT passed.

skipped_reasons.reason: cannot open file ../onnx_node/<op>/onnx.tmfile (external ONNX node test data not present; onnx not installed/vendored per instruction)
skipped_reasons.note: 这 75 个是 ctest 注册的 ONNX 算子测试(tests/op/test_onnx_op_*.cpp)，全部跑在 Tengine CPU 参考后端(create_graph(nullptr,...))，不经过 CUDA 后端，属 CUDA 迁移范围之外。它们在加载模型阶段即因缺少外部 onnx_node 测试数据(onnx.tmfile + input/output .pb)而 Create graph failed，从未进入推理，故非 CoreX/CUDA 缺陷。属客观数据缺失(类比缺权重文件)的合法跳过；原始 ctest 判定为 75 Failed(退出码 8)，同一 open-file 原因，已完整保留在 test.log PART A，此处如实归类为 skipped，未计为通过。75 个测试二进制均已用 CoreX clang++ 编译通过。
